description: Basic HTTP routing from a route to a backend service in the same namespace. Foundation of all routing.
Path and header matching for routing requests to different backends based on request criteria.
Exact path matching where /foo matches only /foo and not /foo/bar.
Traffic distribution across multiple backends based on specified weights for load balancing.
Core Gateway-Route attachment model verifying routes attach correctly and status is tracked.
Multiple listeners with different hostnames routing to different backends.
HTTP listeners on different ports with port-based routing.
